blocks.value: **File name does not match the class name.** `public class Hello` must live in `Hello.java`. The compiler rejects anything else.
**Missing semicolon.** The single most common beginner syntax error. Every statement ends with one.
**Case mismatch.** `system.out.println` and `String[] Args` will not compile. Java is case sensitive everywhere, always.
**Running `java Hello.class`.** The `java` command takes the class name alone: `java Hello`.
**Unbalanced braces.** Every `{` needs its `}`. Indent consistently and this mostly stops happening.
**Assuming no error message means no bug.** Logical errors are silent. Always check that the output is actually correct.
